source.document: Toyota Service Information (TIS) — verbatim trigger language from Toyota TIS repair procedures. Applies to all Toyota and Lexus vehicles: the per-component calibration triggers below are Toyota's standard position across the brand. The PDF/PNG files in makes/sources/toyota/ are representative TIS extracts (pulled from Prius, Camry, and Grand Highlander TIS entries) used to document that language. General scanning requirements per Toyota CRIB 191 (Pre/Post-Repair Diagnostic Scan).
source.note: Lexus uses the same Toyota Information System (TIS) and follows the same calibration procedures. The TIS triggers captured here apply across Toyota and Lexus — the specific model-year documents stored in makes/sources/toyota/ are examples, not model-specific rules. Always verify the procedure for the specific vehicle in TIS.

general_requirements: Per Toyota CRIB 191: 'It is necessary for repairers perform a Health Check diagnostic scan before and after every repair if a vehicle has sustained damage as a result of a collision.' Components from various systems can be damaged in a collision and may not necessarily cause a MIL.

components.calibration_note: If the radar housing shows impact marks or damage on inspection, the sensor must be replaced rather than calibrated.
triggers: The front bumper is damaged or deformed due to an accident or contact with other objects, etc.
The bumper installation area on the body is repaired
The radar sensor or its bracket is removed, loosened, altered, or replaced
The radiator grille is replaced (affects radar line-of-sight)

components.location: Behind front bumper corners, near each headlight assembly
components.calibration_note: Visual inspection of the sensor installation condition is required; if a problem is found the installation position must be adjusted before calibration.
triggers: The headlight assembly is damaged or deformed due to an accident, contact, etc., and repairs have been made to the area of the body to which the headlight assembly is installed
A problem is found during visual inspection of the front side radar sensor installation condition

components.component: Ultrasonic Parking Sensors (Parking Support Brake System / Intelligent Clearance Sonar / Advanced Park)
components.location: Front bumper and rear bumper (ultrasonic sensor array)
triggers: The front bumper is damaged or deformed due to an accident or contact with other objects, etc.
The rear bumper is damaged or deformed due to an accident or contact with other objects, etc.
The front or rear bumper installation area on the body is repaired
Any park assist ultrasonic sensor is removed or replaced
Vehicle height changes (e.g., due to suspension damage or tire replacement) — may also require steering sensor setting

components.component: Panoramic View Monitor (Surround View Camera System)
components.location: Front camera (grille area), rear camera (liftgate/trunk), LH and RH side cameras (under outside mirrors)
components.trigger_lead: Calibration is required when any of the following parts are replaced, removed/installed, or their installation angle changes:
triggers: Front television camera assembly (replacement, or installation angle changes due to removal/installation of the front camera)
Front bumper assembly (installation angle of the front camera changes)
Radiator grille sub-assembly (installation angle of the front camera changes)
Rear television camera assembly (replacement, or installation angle changes due to removal/installation of the rear camera)
Side television camera assembly LH or outer rear view mirror assembly LH (replacement, or installation angle of the side camera changes)
Side television camera assembly RH or outer rear view mirror assembly RH (replacement, or installation angle of the side camera changes)
Steering sensor (removal and installation, connector removal and installation, or replacement — requires steering angle neutral point and steering angle adjustment)
Television camera controller (replacement)
Suspension or tire replacement that changes vehicle height
Replacement or removal/installation of 2 or more of the above parts

components.component: Rear Television Camera (Park Assist Monitor / Back-up Camera)
triggers: Rear television camera assembly is replaced
Installation angle of the rear television camera changes due to removal and installation of the rear camera
Suspension or tire replacement changes vehicle height (for Rear Camera Detection Function)
Trunk lid / liftgate is removed, replaced, or realigned

components.location: Behind rear bumper, mounted to frame / stud bolts inside the rear quarter / bumper support area
components.calibration_note: Sensor deformation from bumper or quarter panel impact is not always externally visible, and a misaimed sensor may not set a DTC. Visually inspect the sensor installation area (frame, stud bolt) for dents or bends, then calibrate to verify proper aim. Do not perform repairs near or over the blind spot sensor radar emission area.
triggers: Rear bumper is damaged or deformed in a collision
Rear quarter panel is damaged in a collision
The quarter panel has been repaired or replaced near the sensor mounting area
The blind spot monitor sensor mounting bracket is damaged
Visual inspection finds the blind spot sensor installation area (frame, stud bolt) dented or bent
The blind spot radar has been removed, installed, or replaced

components.calibration_note: Zero point of the occupant classification sensors can deviate without setting a DTC, so calibration is performed after any collision even when no code is currently present. Seat bolt torque itself warps the seat frame slightly, which changes the load on the sensor — calibration is required any time the seat or its bolts are disturbed.
components.trigger_lead: Zero Point Calibration is required when:
triggers: Vehicle is in for repair after any accident or collision
An occupant classification sensor collision detection DTC is set
The occupant detection ECU is replaced
The front passenger seat is removed from the vehicle
Any of the bolts used to install the front passenger seat are removed and reinstalled
Accessories (seatback tray, seat cover, etc.) are installed on or around the front passenger seat
The passenger airbag ON/OFF indicator illuminates 'ON' when the seat is unoccupied

components.component: Forward Recognition Camera (Lane Departure / LTA / Pre-Collision)
components.location: Behind the windshield, upper center (mounted to windshield bracket)
triggers: The forward recognition camera is removed, installed, or replaced
The windshield is replaced, or removed and reinstalled
